verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP capability list documents searching emails with custom queries and filtering by labels, so basic query search with a label filter exists. Nothing establishes operator syntax, ranking, search speed or coverage of full mail history, and the only evidence is a one-line prose list with no in-app search documentation. Missing for 10: documented search operators, ranked results, evidence of search speed, full-history search coverage, in-app (non-MCP) search docs, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
